newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends steady in a quiet market.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends steady in a quiet market.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka finished steady at 42.5470/5490 to the dollar in a quiet session of interbank trading against the previous 42.5475/5490, dealers said.
The local unit was quoted at 42.5480/5495 per dollar in early trade but gained later as demand for the U.S. currency slumped due to the weekend closure of international markets.
The interbank call money rates finished flat at 4.5 percent to 5.5 percent in a liquid market, dealers said.
